subject: VPC deployment: termination surcharge, tiered support and multi-year packaging
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenbridge.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-09T13:12:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC deployment pricing questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement asked me to follow up with a couple of specific items before we go back to our legal/commercial team:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood applies a termination surcharge for on-prem/VPC contracts if Greenbridge exits before the 24-month minimum? If so, how is it calculated (flat fee, prorated, or % of remaining commits)?
- We need a clear matrix for the platform fee vs. the dedicated reservation SKU — we currently see a platform fee + reserved GPU commit in the draft SOW and want to understand any overlap.
- Support tiers: can you provide the uplift % for Standard -> Business -> Enterprise (with response SLOs), and what is included for escalations (e.g., named SLA manager, quarterly reviews, on-call rotation)?

I've attached our updated SOW with comments. We're targeting a term starting Oct 1st but need clarity on the above to finalize internal approvals.

Best,
Marta
Head of Cloud Ops | Greenbridge Financial
[Attachment: Greenbridge_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB)]

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenbridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T15:07:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC deployment pricing questions

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. Please see answers inline below and a concise counter-proposal at the end. Attaching a matrix for SLAs.

On 2026-08-09 13:12, Marta Ruiz wrote:
> - Can you confirm whether Redwood applies a termination surcharge for on-prem/VPC contracts if Greenbridge exits before the 24-month minimum?

Short answer: we do apply an early-exit recovery charge for multi-year reserved capacity to cover committed provisioning & migration costs, but it's negotiable by term and commit level. Typical approaches:
- Prorated recovery: remaining committed months * platform fee component (not raw GPU list price)
- Flat staging fee: one-time amount to cover migration/clean-up (~$25k typical for medium deployments)

Counter-proposal for Greenbridge depending on commitment:
- 24-month, 100k token/month baseline commit: no flat staging fee; prorated recovery applies (we cap at 6 months of platform fee)
- 36-month, 150k token/month baseline: we waive recovery charge entirely if we receive a 20% commitment deposit (applied to first invoice)

> - We need a clear matrix for the platform fee vs. the dedicated reservation SKU

Platform fee covers the private control plane, security/hardening, automatic routing, and console features (observability, usage analytics). Dedicated reservation SKU covers GPUs/instances (throughput). There is not double-billing: the platform fee is separate and covers ongoing product-level services. For Greenbridge we suggest:
- Platform fee (annual): $45k/year (for our Enterprise checkbox: extra observability retention + audit log export)
- Reserved capacity: quoted separately by GPU type; see SOW lines 12-16.

> - Support tiers: uplift % and escalation specifics

Support uplift (examples):
- Standard: included (email support, 24 business-hour response)
- Business: +18% of platform fee (4hr response for Sev 1, named CSM, quarterly business review)
- Enterprise: +38% of platform fee (1hr response for Sev 1, 24/7 phone escalation, named escalation engineer + monthly ops review)

For Greenbridge we can include a dedicated escalation path: named Escalation Lead (Ben) and onboarding war-room for the first 60 days. We will add guaranteed RTO/RPO language into SLA_matrix.xlsx for Enterprise.

Attachments: SLA_matrix.xlsx (contains SLOs and remediation credit ladder).

Next steps (short):
1) Confirm which counter you prefer (24m capped recovery vs. 36m deposit-waive).
2) If ok, I'll ask Legal to draft a redline-friendly SOW and provide a DocuSign-ready SOW and an amended SLA.
3) We'll include a one-time onboarding credit (one week reduced platform fee) upon signing.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk the execs through the tradeoffs.

Thanks,
Tessa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12KB)]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenbridge.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-10T09:23:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC deployment pricing questions

Tessa — this is helpful, thanks. A few clarifications from procurement & finance:

- The platform fee of $45k/year is higher than we expected. Is there room to shift some features (audit log export, extended retention) into a priced add-on instead of the base platform fee? Our finance prefers a lower fixed platform fee + optional add-ons.

- For the recovery cap: capping at 6 months of platform fee is acceptable to legal, but we would prefer the cap be expressed in dollars and applied only to platform fee portion (not GPU spend). Can you make that explicit in SOW language?

- Can you confirm whether the onboarding credit is applied as invoice credit or a service credit (i.e., ported to future months)?

Also, can you share the name of your Legal contact so we can start the redline?

Thanks,
Marta

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenbridge.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-10T12:31:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC deployment pricing questions

Hi Marta — looping in for legal/finance clarifications.

We can accommodate the platform fee split: base platform fee reduced to $30k/year + optional add-ons (Audit Export: $10k/year, Extended Retention 90d -> 1yr: $8k/year). We'll reflect each as separate line items so Greenbridge can choose.

On recovery cap: we'll update the SOW clause to state: 'Early-exit recovery shall be limited to a maximum of $27,000 (equivalent to 6 months of the base platform fee) and applies only to the platform fee component; GPU/instance charges are excluded.'

On onboarding credit: we apply as an invoice credit against the first invoice unless you prefer a service credit schedule — invoice credit is standard and speedier for finance reconciliation.

Legal contact: Rachel Kim, Contracts Manager (rachel_kim@redwood.com). Rachel will receive the SOW draft and respond to redlines.

If that structure works we'll produce an updated SOW with line items and explicit early-exit text.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@greenbridge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-12T18:04:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC deployment pricing questions

Laura/Tessa — thanks for the fast turnaround and for splitting the platform fee. That proposal is much easier to justify internally.

A couple of final asks before we route to legal:
- Please add a sentence that the early-exit recovery cap ($27,000) will be waived if Greenbridge pays the 20% deposit on the 36-month term.
- Can you include a 90-day notice period for any price increases to the platform fee during the term? Procurement requires notice windows.

Assuming those two items are included in the SOW we'll move to redlines and loop Rachel. Prefer a DocuSign path once redlines are resolved.

I'll schedule an internal quick sync for Fri to align our exec sponsors, but would like to have the updated SOW before then.

Best,
Marta
Head of Cloud Ops | Greenbridge Financial
